newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 335,000 to 350,000 head versus 359,000 a week ago and 369,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 60,000 to 65,000 head versus 33,000 a week ago and 216,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 128,000 to 130,000 head versus 136,000 a week ago and 133,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 30,000 to 45,000 head versus 39,000 a week ago and 38,000 a year ago.
